values.meaning: Total bracing duration before the smash lands
Lockout portion of the brace during which Ambessa cannot act
values.quote: the first {{fd|0.225}} seconds she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}

mechanics.claim: The smash's damage is increased by 50% only if the on-cast shield mitigates damage from a champion, large monster, or turret before the smash lands.
mechanics.quote: If the shield mitigates any amount of damage taken from {{tip|champions}}, large {{tip|monsters}}, or {{tip|turret|turrets}} before '''Ambessa''' smashes the ground, ''Repudiation's'' damage is increased by 50%.

mechanics.claim: The shield is granted at the moment of cast (before the smash resolves), so it can absorb damage during the brace window.
mechanics.quote: '''Ambessa''' {{tip|shield|shields}} herself at the time of cast

mechanics.claim: The shield buff and shield health are not actually displayed/applied until a short, inconsistent delay after cast, which is a bug.
mechanics.quote: ''Repudiation's'' shield buff and shield health on the health bar UI are not granted to and displayed on the caster on-cast, but rather only after a very short, inconsistent delay from the time of cast.

mechanics.claim: Ambessa is unable to act during the first 0.225 seconds of the brace, and only certain casts are allowed in the remaining 0.275 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Other abilities may be cast in the last {{fd|0.275}} seconds of the brace after the lockout and are otherwise disabled in the first {{fd|0.225}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: The ability deals area damage to nearby enemies when the ground smash occurs, after the full brace completes (or at the end of a buffered dash).
mechanics.quote: she smashes the ground beneath her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies
